description:
Activate Grinding Station by tapping it and sacrificing Phyrexian Walker
When Phyrexian Walker dies, Mortuary triggers, putting Phyrexian Walker from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Grinding Station ability.
Cast Phyrexian Walker from the top of your library by paying 0 life.
When Phyrexian Walker enters, Grinding Station triggers, untapping Grinding Station.
Repeat.
